notes.title: Save a cute cat from bats! Play "Draw & Guard"!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109371/5b2d2d389bde21b7c1774780edd0d9ef1ba066e3.jpg[/img]

[b]"YEAH! YOU WANT "THOSE GAMES," RIGHT? SO HERE YOU GO! NOW, LET'S SEE YOU CLEAR THEM! 2"[/b] is available now on Steam Store.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2744230

One of the mini-games included in this title, [b]"Draw & Guard,"[/b] is a game in which you draw a line with a single stroke to prevent a cute cat from being attacked by bats.

The key is to connect the lines firmly, since if the lines are broken, bats will enter through the gaps.

But beware! Even if your lines are perfect, a fall onto a ground obstacle can spell the end.

Analyze the scene, draw a line, and defend your kitten from the bats!

[h3]Challenge players from around the world![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109371/5ed9be86fad95f4c8789f4dc700c7915fb2d8aa3.png[/img]

Clearing all minigame stages will unlock a Rank-Up Challenge, where you can compare your score and clear time to other players in monthly rankings.

Ranking is based on each mini-game or a mix of five different mini-games, with “Easy,” “Normal,” and “Difficult” levels for each.

*Rankings are reset on the 1st of each month.

notes.title: Let's play "Those Games 2" for brain exercise during break time!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109371/c0d35f77a513ac6ae4dad1ba418072389c02360e.jpg[/img]

[b]"YEAH! YOU WANT "THOSE GAMES," RIGHT? SO HERE YOU GO! NOW, LET'S SEE YOU CLEAR THEM! 2"[/b] is available now on Steam Store.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2744230

The mini-game [b]"Numbers Dungeon"[/b] included in "Those Games 2" is a puzzle game in which players take turns defeating enemies whose numbers are smaller than their own.

By adding the numbers of defeated enemies to your own numbers, you will be able to take on stronger and stronger enemies.

Sometimes you can pick up an item that doubles your numbers, but other times you may be caught in a trap that halves them.....

Calculations such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division are key in figuring out the order in which to obtain items and defeat enemies.

Playing in a little spare time in a fun way can be a refreshing change of pace and a good exercise for your brain!

[h3]Other fun mini-games are also included![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109371/6bbdb4fe30edc1d6d8ccbc78393d175ff068edd7.jpg[/img]

A total of 250 stages in five types are included, including [b]"Knock-Back Shooter"[/b], a game in which players use walls to knock down monsters, [b]"Pin Pull 2"[/b] in which they pull pins to save the king from a pinch, [b]"Draw & Guard"[/b] in which they draw lines to save a cat from bats, and [b]"Spellbinding Scroll"[/b] in which they make numbers bigger to attract boys!

notes.title: Play "Those games" to exercise your brain in your spare time!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44392250/5beac72aefeebab6ad45deab335572d9af9ac49d.jpg[/img]

"YEAH! YOU WANT "THOSE GAMES," RIGHT? SO HERE YOU GO! NOW, LET'S SEE YOU CLEAR THEM!", also known as [b]"Those Games"[/b], is now available on Steam Store!

"Those games" includes a total of [b]250 stages[/b] in five categories: "Number Tower", "Pin Pull", "Color Lab", "Parking Lot" and "Cash Run”!

By playing in your spare time in a fun and easy way, you can exercise your mind and change your mood!

Today, we will introduce the remaining four mini-games following "Number Tower".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44392250/2603927a6568d9253a98b78d28d386d1d2dda808.png[/img]

[b]"Pin Pull"[/b] is a game in which players pull out pins on the stage and use rocks and other gimmicks to obtain treasures without being interrupted by enemies.
The order in which the pins are pulled out is the key to clear the game, so try to pull out the pins while looking ahead.

In [b]"Color Lob"[/b], players transfer drugs in a test tube and sort them by color, such as red or blue.
The key to clear the game is to complete one color at first while making good use of empty test tubes.

In [b]"Parking Lot"[/b], the game is completed when all the cars are sent out of the parking lot by moving forward or backward.
If you hit a car, you will only lose time, but if you hit bad boys, who appears in the latter stage, the game ends immediately, so be careful!
The order in which the cars are moved and the timing of the movement are also keys to clear the game.

[b]"Cash Run"[/b] is a game in which players use the money they collect to overcome obstacles and reach the goal.
The amount of money you can earn changes depending on the gates that appear, so check your earning rate as you progress through the game and acquire a richer house!

"YEAH! YOU WANT "THOSE GAMES," RIGHT? SO HERE YOU GO! NOW, LET'S SEE YOU CLEAR THEM!" is available now.
